motivation: Saved fixed continuous fits converge9/10 but same-model reselection converges0/10. Test a bounded selection-and-refit loop with explicit source and normalizer changes
data_role: Already viewed outcome-informed development, not held-out validation
work_bounds: At most3 association rounds. Each calls the original fitted-field admission refiner with cap30, for at most90 applied corrections overall. Stop after an inner guard or unconverged inner budget, rather than hiding that failure by another selection. No extra budget or best-outcome selection after viewing results
inner_model: Unchanged one-sided C1 inverse-depth field, original bilinear center seed and normalizers, original nine model-domain probes and minimum200 sources per factor. Freeze complete source set, point/normal values and metric normalizers throughout each inner attempt. Same Huber0.01m,21 Armijo candidates1..2^-20 and slack, SPD condition1e6, current support, full-proposal0.1m/0.15rad bounds and strict1e-5m/1e-5rad convergence
between_rounds: Only after a completed fixed fit, run the same original admission policy at its terminal pose, including newly computed bilinear-center normalizers. Retain exact old/new/shared/lost/added source counts, shared source digest, exact source point/normal parity, changed normalizer counts and ratio min/median/max. Reselected metadata becomes the next round's fixed population. Dropping sources is allowed only at this explicit boundary; no100% retention claim
prior_ownership: Every round evaluates the same original incoming nonlinear prior once, with original anchors/information and consumed-pair ownership checks. No cumulative prior addition, remarginalization, tracker/prior/Schur commit, root change or new current acquisition
stop_order: Inner guard, inner budget, fresh continuous selection guard, fixed-and-fresh continuous convergence, then round3 budget. No round follows a terminal condition. Early success is same-model stationarity under the unchanged strict full-proposal gate, without replacing the separately retained original-discrete fresh check
comparison: Start at the same original poses and prior as the archived single90-cap admission control. All prior first fits finish by27 or initial guard, so the full first cap30 report must match the archived cap90 report exactly except cap. Verify every original control and every new inner trace, fresh continuous system and transition independently
costs: Within each inner attempt require the original fixed-objective Armijo rule. Reselection changes population/normalization and therefore objective composition and prior balance; preserve cost changes at equal poses and do not infer monotonic optimization or physical accuracy across that boundary. Do not choose an earlier lower-residual state after seeing the last result
independent_verification: Separate original center/source selector, homogeneous probes, polynomial sampler, SVD normals, incidence/prior matrices, spectral solves and Rodrigues search verify full inner reports. Independent dictionary identity sets and weight-ratio aggregation verify transition receipts. Original PNG hashes, timestamps and axial-Z /5000 once precede both constructions; decoded observations remain shared
analytic_controls: A2mm-quantized rendered moving-view fixture exercises two actual rounds; a separate nonzero prior fixture checks unchanged ownership across rounds. Missing/plane data retain guards. Seven scheduling cases and invalid round inputs check precedence/bounds, six outer-report corruptions are rejected, and pose-count/origin/current-prior input guards are exercised. Original inner controls retain12 nonzero-prior gradient axes
known_unresolved_analytic_limit: Exact-grid identical rendered views produce different admitted source sets in the existing operational and independent nine-probe implementations, with and without2mm quantization. Preserve both full identity answers and source-projection grid distances; require the auditor to reject the mismatch. This remains unresolved and is not a passed identity-convergence fixture or reason to relax matching. Recorded stages must agree exactly on source identities and within original tolerances on values
followup_numerical_progression_rule: Both cases must converge all five fixed-and-fresh continuous windows, improve original-discrete fresh convergence versus the control, have no local/discrete guard, pass0.03m original-discrete RMS and have median original-discrete RMS no worse than the control. Unresolved analytic domain disagreement additionally precludes adoption; retain numerical progression separately from general validity
scope: No new numeric real reference labels, physical pose-error score, continuous trajectory, native/default adoption, vehicle integration or timing claim. New/control/round checks share existing observations, and analytic agreement is limited by the explicitly preserved identity-domain disagreement
